purpose: Correct the ASVS V6.3.7 decision, which recorded FAIL on a factually wrong basis. The earlier note asserted that nothing in this repository turns the password-reset confirm() response into a sent email; the scan behind that claim was scoped to apps/api and generalised to the whole repository, and its call-site counts were taken by substring rather than word boundary. Both notices the requirement asks about are in fact sent, localised, from the web BFF. Evidence-register correction only - no application code changes.
requiredInvariants: Only the V6.3.7 decision changes; no other requirement's verdict, evidence or conditions are touched.
The new PASS carries self-revoking conditions tied to the actual send call sites, so removing either notification revokes the decision instead of leaving a stale PASS.
A condition also watches for the appearance of a username/email change flow, which would make the requirement's currently-vacuous third clause real and must re-open the assessment.

The durability limitation of the BFF send (no retry; a crash after the API commit leaves that user unnotified) is recorded honestly in the note rather than being hidden by the PASS, and is explicitly not scored as a failure of this requirement, which asks whether users are notified rather than whether delivery is guaranteed.
No security control is weakened; no application code changes.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
acceptance: The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions and all three V6.3.7 conditions hold against the live tree.
The FAIL count drops by exactly one (122 to 121); decisionsApplied stays 332.
A file-wide applicability/status consistency check reports 0 inconsistencies.
